title: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Enforcement of Women Ownership Rights Act 2012

sections.shortTitle: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Enforcement of Women Ownership Rights Act 2012
sections.description:
Short title, extent and commencement

ACT III OF 2012
ACT III OF 2012
KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA ENFORCEMENT
OF WOMEN OWNERSHIP RIGHTS ACT,
2012.
An Act to protect and secure the right of ownership
of women in the property
[Gazette of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa,
Extraordinary,
17th January, 2012]
No.
PA/ Khyber Pakhutnkhwa/ Bills/
2012/ 2336-37, dated 17-1-2012.-The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Enforcement of Women Ownership Rights Bill,
2012 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Khybver
Pakhtunkhwa on 5th January, 2012 and assented to by
the Governor of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa on 13th
January, 2012 is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Legislature of
the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.
Whereas
the Islamic Sharia provides equal guarantee for the
protection of life and property of men and women;
And
Whereas the Constitution of Pakistan, 1973, and section 5 of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Shari Act, 2003, enjoins upon the Government to
legislate with respect to the protection of the said right;
And
Whereas the Sharia gives due respect to the women in
society and guarantees their right of ownership;
And
Whereas the rights of ownership of women is at stake in the society and such
rights are violated by means of coercion, fraud, fabrication, forgery, cheating
and it is necessary to protect and secure the said rights of women in the
society; Therefore it is hereby enacted as
follows:
1. Short
title, extent and commencement.--- (1) This Act
may be called the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Enforcement of
Women Ownership Rights Act, 2012.
(2) It
extends to the whole of the Khyber
Pakhtunkhwa
Province.
(3) It
shall come into force at once.

2. Definitions.---In this Act, unless the context otherwise requires;
(a) "Ownership"
means the right of ownership in the property both movable and immovable which
is devolved upon and vested in women by way of inheritance, gift, purchase, mehr or acquired by her by way of any other legal and Shari
means; and
(b) "Government"
means the Government of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.

4. Punishment.---(1)
Whoever contravenes or abets in the contravention of the provisions of section
3 shall be punishable with imprisonment of either description for a term not
exceeding five years and fine not exceeding fifty thousand rupees:
Provided that this punishment shall be in addition to the
punishment provided by any other law for the time being in force for such
offence.
(2) Whenever a
person is convicted
of an offence
under sub-section (1), the Court
shall handover possession of the property, on account of which the person has
been so convicted to the rightful owner.
(3) Whenever
a woman files a suit, the Court shall decide the case in six months and the
judgment and decree of the Court shall be implemented by the Court through
local police in the supervision of the Court within one month of decision of
the case, failing which the said officer shall be charged under section 5.
